strings.prefs_camera_package_spoof_screen_summar: The camera sees another app name and opens hidden modules.
strings.prefs_camera_sounds_summary: The click of a shot. It sounds only in the normal ring mode. Where the law requires a shutter sound, it is always there.
strings.prefs_colour_cal_hue_summary: Turns this primary colour of the camera round the colour wheel, and with it every colour that contains it. At zero it is as the camera renders it.
strings.prefs_colour_cal_sat_summary: Higher: this primary colour is richer. Lower: duller. At zero it is as the camera renders it. White stays white.
strings.prefs_colour_calibration_screen_summary: The hue and saturation of the camera's three primary colours: red, green and blue.
strings.prefs_colour_gamut_summary: Neon, LEDs and other very saturated colours keep their hue instead of turning into a flat patch. Higher: stronger protection. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_colour_grade_balance_summary: Where shadows end and highlights begin. Higher: more of the photo counts as highlights. Lower: as shadows.
strings.prefs_colour_grade_blend_summary: How smoothly the tinted zones blend into each other.
strings.prefs_colour_grade_hue_summary: The tint's colour on the colour wheel: 0 red, 60 yellow, 120 green, 180 cyan, 240 blue, 300 magenta.
strings.prefs_colour_grade_str_summary: How visible the tint is. At zero there is none.
strings.prefs_colour_grading_screen_summary: Tinting the shadows, mid-tones and highlights with a colour of their own, as in films.
strings.prefs_colour_hue_lock_summary: Keeps the tone curve from distorting hues in bright places, such as pulling a blue sky to turquoise or violet and orange to yellow. Full holds every hue up to white, Blues only holds just the blues, Off leaves the colours as the curve makes them.
strings.prefs_colour_keep_cool_summary: In the shade and on overcast days part of the blue stays in the photo. At zero the light is fully neutral.
strings.prefs_colour_keep_warm_summary: Under incandescent lamps and at sunset part of the warmth stays in the photo instead of being removed by auto white balance. At zero the light is fully neutral.
strings.prefs_colour_mix_hue_summary: Shifts this colour toward its neighbours on the colour wheel. At zero as it is.
strings.prefs_colour_mix_light_summary: Higher: this colour is lighter. Lower: darker. At zero as it is.
strings.prefs_colour_mix_sat_summary: Higher: this colour is richer. Lower: duller. At −100 it is grey.
strings.prefs_colour_mixer_screen_summary: The hue, saturation and brightness of eight colours, each on its own.
strings.prefs_colour_mono_summary: A colour filter for the black-and-white photo, as on black-and-white film. Yellow darkens the sky a little, orange and red more. Green lightens leaves, blue the sky.
strings.prefs_colour_skin_even_summary: Evens out blotchy redness on skin by pulling its hues together. Higher: more even skin. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_colour_skin_hue_summary: Makes skin redder or more golden; other colours do not change. Higher: more golden. Lower: redder. At zero as it is.
strings.prefs_colour_tint_summary: Shifts the photo's colour toward magenta or green on top of the automatic white balance, for example to remove a green cast from lamps. At zero it is as the camera judged.
strings.prefs_colour_warmth_summary: Makes every shot warmer or cooler on top of the automatic white balance. At zero it is as the camera judged.
strings.prefs_config_portable_note_summary: A config can be moved to another phone: the lens profiles are matched by focal length.
strings.prefs_crop_upscale_summary: A shot with a crop or digital zoom is enlarged to the full photo size. Off: it stays smaller, without enlarging.
strings.prefs_dcp_profile_summary: The colour profile of this module: the camera's own or a loaded DCP file, a profile in Adobe's format. It changes how the camera renders colours.
strings.prefs_debug_merge_stamp_summary: The photo's top right corner shows whether the extra-short (ES) and long (L) frames went into it, and if not, a short reason code.
strings.prefs_debug_merge_stamp_title: ES / L stamp on the photo
strings.prefs_desc_pref_scam_hybrid_boost_value: How hard moving things are cut out where parts of the frame move differently. Higher: no doubling of passing people and cars at all, but a noisier shot. Lower: a gentler merge with less noise on things that sway slightly.
strings.prefs_desc_pref_scam_hybrid_why_agx_ev: Shifts the brightness before the AgX curve, in stops. Higher: a lighter photo. Lower: a darker one. Works in the Custom look.
strings.prefs_desc_pref_scam_hybrid_why_agx_max_: The upper end of the AgX curve's range, in stops. Higher: more room for highlights and less clipping, but a flatter picture. Lower: lights turn white sooner. Works in the Custom look.
strings.prefs_desc_pref_scam_hybrid_why_agx_min_: The lower end of the AgX curve's range, in stops from middle grey. The lower it is, the more shadow detail stays and the flatter the picture. The higher, the sooner shadows go black. Works in the Custom look.
strings.prefs_desc_pref_scam_hybrid_why_agx_sat: How saturated the photo's colours are. Higher: richer. Lower: paler. At zero the photo is black and white.
strings.prefs_desc_pref_scam_hybrid_why_agx_sp: How rounded the top of the curve is: how softly bright highlights roll into white. Higher: the lights stay bright longer and end more abruptly. Lower: they roll off more smoothly. Works in the Custom look.
strings.prefs_desc_pref_scam_hybrid_why_agx_tp: How rounded the bottom of the curve is: how dark tones pass into black. Higher: denser, darker shadows. Lower: softer and lighter. Works in the Custom look.
strings.prefs_desc_pref_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl: How much of the first stage's restored sharpness is mixed into the photo. Higher: clearly sharper. Zero turns it off.
How many passes the first stage makes. Higher: sharper, but slower and with possible halos. Lower: faster with less risk of noise. Zero turns it off.
How much of this stage's restored sharpness is mixed into the photo. Higher: sharper. Lower: softer. Zero turns it off.
How many passes this stage makes. Higher: stronger, but slower and with possible halos. Lower: weaker. Zero turns it off.
How much of this stage's restored sharpness is mixed into the photo. Higher: sharper. Lower: softer. Zero turns it off.
How many passes this stage makes. Higher: stronger, but slower and with possible halos. Lower: weaker. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_desc_pref_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_us: The strength of the unsharp mask's edge sharpening. Higher: a crisply sharp picture. Lower: a soft, natural image without oversharpening. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_desc_pref_watermark_logo: The SCAMERA camera icon next to the text, with its light in the camera's yellow. On its own it is a watermark too.
strings.prefs_developer_settings_screen_summary: Hidden parameters of the scam_dev.txt file for experiments and debugging.
strings.prefs_dng_lossless_summary: The raw DNG file is compressed with no quality loss and takes about 40 percent less space. It saves a little slower, and not every app opens it.
strings.prefs_ettr_summary: Frames are taken brighter while the photo keeps its usual brightness, so the shadows have less noise. Indoors and at night it usually does nothing.
strings.prefs_expert_sensor_screen_summary: Where the black and white levels come from: each frame's own data or the camera's fixed values.
strings.prefs_face_contrast_summary: The contrast on faces, relative to the skin's own brightness.
strings.prefs_face_detail_summary: On the plus side the fine detail of a face is sharper, on the minus side softer.
strings.prefs_face_detect_summary: Finds faces in the frame, outlines them and puts focus and exposure on them. A tap on the screen and manual focus come first.
strings.prefs_face_exposure_summary: The brightness of faces, in stops. The rest of the photo does not change.
strings.prefs_face_mask_on_summary: Turns on separate processing of faces: the rows below change faces only. Off: faces are processed like the rest of the photo.
strings.prefs_face_mask_show_summary: For tuning: on the next shots the face mask is painted red so that you can see what it covers.
strings.prefs_face_mask_size_summary: The size of the processed area relative to the face the camera found, in percent.
strings.prefs_face_mask_skin_summary: How strictly the mask follows skin colour. 0 is the whole oval of the face with hair and eyes, 100 is skin only.
strings.prefs_face_saturation_summary: How saturated the colour of faces is.
strings.prefs_face_smooth_summary: Removes the finest skin texture, pores and noise. At 100 the skin is as smooth as it gets.
strings.prefs_face_tint_summary: On the plus side faces are more magenta, on the minus side greener.
strings.prefs_face_warmth_summary: On the plus side faces are warmer, on the minus side cooler.
strings.prefs_file_format_summary: The format photos are saved in and their quality. If unsure, leave JPEG.
strings.prefs_file_name_summary: The pattern new photos are named by. The line under the title shows the name of a photo taken now.
strings.prefs_film_data_credit_summary: Film and paper profiles: spektrafilm by Andrea Volpato, github.com/andreavolpato/spektrafilm, CC BY-SA 4.0 (converted and modified by SCAMERA: binary arrays and derived LUTs, see assets/film/CHANGELOG.txt). The colour model, the DIR couplers and the diffusion filters are ports of spektrafilm (GPL-3.0); the 65 mm and IMAX 70 formats and the grain blur's format scale come from spektrafilm OFX by Aedan Diez, github.com/chaert-s/spektrafilm-ofx (GPL-3.0, see assets/film/NOTICE-spektrafilm-ofx.txt). Text recognition in the gallery: Tesseract OCR and its tessdata_fast models (Apache-2.0), github.com/tesseract-ocr, through Tesseract4Android by Adaptech (Apache-2.0).
strings.prefs_film_lut_screen_summary: Ready film colours. A LUT is a table that recolours the photo in the chosen style. This page shows what exactly it changes.
strings.prefs_film_lut_strength_summary: How strongly the LUT colours the photo. 0: not at all. 100: at full strength.
strings.prefs_film_sim_screen_summary: The photo goes through a model of film and print: colour, tone, grain and halation. The film's frame size changes the grain.
strings.prefs_focus_screen_summary: Autofocus, face detection, subject tracking and focus peaking.
strings.prefs_fringe_net_screen_summary: Fine tuning of the network that removes colour fringes: how strongly it works and which fringes it treats as a defect.
strings.prefs_fullres_hw_remosaic_summary: A 50 MP shot arrives already assembled into an ordinary frame by the sensor itself, as in the stock camera. Off: the camera takes the raw Quad or Tetra mosaic and assembles the frame itself. 200 MP is always assembled by SCAMERA: the sensor cannot do it. On the vivo X100 Ultra and X300 Ultra this applies to the main camera only.
strings.prefs_gallery_screen_summary: The gallery's theme and its icon on the home screen.
strings.prefs_hdr_frames_summary: The camera adds short and long frames to keep detail in very bright and very dark places. Off: only ordinary frames are used, with fewer traces on motion and a slightly narrower brightness range.
strings.prefs_heic_10bit_summary: 10 bits a colour instead of 8: the sky and other smooth gradients come out without steps. Needs Android 13 or newer.
strings.prefs_heic_quality_summary: How hard the HEIC is compressed. Higher: a larger, more detailed file. Lower: a lighter file that loses fine detail.
strings.prefs_jpeg_fast_encoder_summary: The system encoder saves the photo. That is about twice as fast, but the file is a little larger and the colour of fine detail is coarser.
strings.prefs_jpeg_quality_summary: How hard the JPEG is compressed. Higher: a larger, more detailed file. Lower: a lighter file that loses fine detail.
strings.prefs_keep_raw_burst_summary: Every shot keeps its raw burst in Download/SCAMERA so the merge can be examined. The files are large, up to several gigabytes a shot at 50 MP. Delete them once you have sent them.
strings.prefs_lens_filter_screen_summary: A soft glow round bright places, as from a glass filter in front of the lens: Glimmerglass, Black Pro-Mist, Pro-Mist, CineBloom.
strings.prefs_lens_keys_category_summary: Camera2 keys of the session and of the requests, the sensor mode
strings.prefs_lens_screen_summary: Everything about the module itself: the sensor, the RAW format, levels, the colour matrix and noise.
strings.prefs_low_light_boost_summary: In the dark the viewfinder gets brighter, but updates less often and the frames for the shot get longer. Needs Android 15; does not work in Sport mode.
strings.prefs_modules_screen_summary: The zoom buttons of the viewfinder: which phone camera each one opens, its zoom and its sensor settings.
strings.prefs_mosaic_wb_summary: For full-resolution shots (50 and 200 MP) and in-sensor zoom, SCAMERA computes the white balance. Off: the camera's own white balance is used.
strings.prefs_noise_model_note_summary: Any chosen noise profile except Auto replaces the camera's data in the merge, the noise reduction, the frame alignment and the DNG.
strings.prefs_oldstyle_tone_reset_summary: Puts every slider and switch of this page back to its default. The chosen tone version (V1 / V2) and the style on the camera screen stay.
strings.prefs_oldstyle_tone_screen_summary: The tone of the “ScamMaster” camera mode: V1 the look of the old version 2.7, V2 of 3.1. ScamMaster captures as “Photo” does (the same camera exposure, the same burst, no ultrashort and no long frames) — only the tone of the finished photo differs. The rows of this page change the tone, not the camera's exposure; rows of the other version are greyed.
strings.prefs_photo_also_jpeg_summary: A JPEG copy is saved beside the HEIC, WebP or AVIF, for apps that cannot open those formats.
strings.prefs_photo_color_space_summary: sRGB looks the same on any screen. Display P3 holds richer colours: brighter on wide-colour screens, a little paler where P3 is not supported.
strings.prefs_photo_format_summary: The format photos are saved in. JPEG opens everywhere. HEIC, WebP and AVIF take less space but do not open everywhere.
strings.prefs_photo_hdr_summary: A brightness map is saved with the photo: Ultra HDR in JPEG or an HDR map in 10-bit HEIC and AVIF. On an HDR screen bright places glow brighter; on an ordinary one it is just a photo.
strings.prefs_photo_size_screen_summary: How many pixels a photo has and what happens to it after the merge.
strings.prefs_photo_style_summary: Normal colour, black and white, or film: film colours, the film simulation and a lens filter.
strings.prefs_portrait_ae_summary: How strongly the exposure adapts to the faces in the frame. Higher: faces are lit right even against the sun, though the background may get lighter. At zero faces do not affect the exposure.
strings.prefs_portrait_awb_summary: White balance with an eye on the faces: the colour of the whole photo shifts so that skin gets closer to its natural tone. 0 is off, 1 is full strength. Small deviations are left alone.
strings.prefs_portrait_curve_on_summary: When a face is found in the frame, the shot is processed with this curve and its modifiers instead of the usual one.
strings.prefs_portrait_curve_points_summary: The tone curve for shots with faces. Soft by default, gentle on shadows. Tap to change it.
strings.prefs_portrait_enabled_summary: If the camera finds a face, the shot gets no extra contrast and the shadows on the face come out softer. Shots without faces do not change.
strings.prefs_portrait_mask_summary: Separate processing of faces only: their brightness, contrast, colour, and the smoothing and sharpness of skin.
strings.prefs_portrait_skin_warmth_summary: When the light has made skin clearly yellow or bluish and the grey and white things in the frame carry the same cast, the skin is brought back toward its natural colour. The background and normally coloured skin do not change.
strings.prefs_portrait_summary: What the camera does when it finds a face in the frame: softer contrast, natural skin colour, separate processing of the face.
strings.prefs_profiles_load_summary: Loads the settings from an .xml file in the SCAMERA folder. The current settings are replaced.
strings.prefs_profiles_reset_summary: Puts every setting back as it was right after installing.
strings.prefs_profiles_save_summary: Saves every setting into one file, a new profile.
strings.prefs_profiles_screen_summary: Save every setting to a file, load them back, or reset them to how they were after installing.
strings.prefs_raw_black_from_data_summary: If the camera reports too high a black level, it is taken from the frame itself. Turn it on if the shadows of your photos look green.
strings.prefs_raw_crop_auto_summary: If the raw frame has empty black stripes at its edges, they are cut off on every shot. That happens on the vivo X200 Pro and X200 Pro mini.
strings.prefs_raw_crop_preview_summary: Shows how the frame is cropped on a portrait shot. You can drag an edge of the box with a finger.
strings.prefs_raw_crop_screen_summary: Cropping the edges of the raw frame: the black stripes the camera delivers and your own margins on each side.
strings.prefs_raw_crop_side_summary: How many sensor pixels to cut from this side of a portrait shot, beyond the black stripes. Removes stripes and junk pixels at the frame's edge.
strings.prefs_raw_lsc_mode_summary: Evens out the brightness of the frame's corners with the lens map. «Do not apply» is for a camera that already corrected the raw frame itself, when the corners come out too bright.
strings.prefs_raw_stream_format_summary: The form in which the camera delivers raw frames. Auto takes RAW10 when the camera offers it and the data fits 10 bits, otherwise 16 bit or RAW12. Change it only if photos come out with wrong brightness or colour.
strings.prefs_root_enabled_summary: Not required. Only a build in which the processor is not installed as part of the app needs it: then it starts through su.
strings.prefs_root_modules_summary: The zoom buttons of the viewfinder. Tap a module to change it
strings.prefs_scam_diagnostics_screen_summary: The app's log, processing stages and reports, to look into a failure or an odd photo.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_artifacts_screen_summa: Recovering blown highlights and fighting the colour fringes and dotted lines at bright edges.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_auto2x_summary: The 2× grid is used only in good light and when the frames really add detail. Otherwise the shot is simply enlarged: faster and without grid traces.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_chroma_sigma_sum: Smooths the colour of the short frames at the edges of blown areas. Higher: more even colour. Lower: a coloured dotted line. For the ordinary merge only; it does nothing in the native Quad and Tetra merge.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_chroma_sigma_tit: Highlight frames: highlight edge colour, σ px
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_factor_summary: How many times darker the dark frame is than an ordinary one. Higher: rescues brighter lamps, but noisier. Lower: the other way round.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_factor_title: Highlight frames: how many times shorter than N
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_frames_summary: How many dark frames to take. Higher: less noise in the highlights, but slightly longer shooting.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_motion_max_summa: Guards against doubled headlights and street lamps when shooting handheld. Lower: a strict choice, and at the slightest shake the base frame is kept without doubled lights. At 100 rejection is off and the short frame is always merged.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_ramp_summary: How smoothly the dark frames come in at blown areas. At zero the transition is the sharpest; higher makes the edge of the area where they replace the base frames softer. Separate bright objects are not affected.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_scam_summary: Checks the dark frame more strictly and skips it if it would spoil the photo. Off: the earlier checks apply.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_sigma_summary: For the native Quad and Tetra merge only: how much the dark frame is blurred in the highlights. Higher: softer lights. Below 0.7 coloured teeth appear on the edges. On an ordinary sensor the softness is set by «Highlight frames: soft transition».
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_summary: An extra very dark frame rescues blown areas such as lamps and the sky. Auto takes it only when the frame has blown areas.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_trigger_summary: For Auto: at what share of blown pixels the dark frame is taken. Higher: less often. Lower: more often.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_trigger_title: Highlight frames: clipping threshold for Auto
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_bento_validate_summary: How strictly dark frames are checked for motion. Stricter: fewer dark silhouettes of hands against lamps.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_boost_threshold_summar: How textured an area must be for the stronger motion rejection to start. Higher: only on clearly contrasty objects. Lower: even on low-contrast areas.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_cdm_summary: How strictly the merge rejects what moves. Higher: no ghosts of passing people and cars, but a noisier shot. Lower: more frames go into the merge, with possible ghosts.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_cell_clip_summary: Protects against purple fringes round lamps and blown areas, but also throws out dark dots next to the light from every frame, so edges against bright light come out jagged. Off by default: the merge clips blown areas dot by dot.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_chroma_diff_clamp_summ: Keeps colour from running along thin lines while the coloured zigzag is removed. It does nothing in the native Quad and Tetra merge.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_chroma_diff_summary: Removes the coloured zigzag on the edges of moving objects. Higher: stronger. Zero turns it off. It does nothing in the native Quad and Tetra merge.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_cre_source_summary: What aligns the burst's frames: the system module (vivo only) or the one built into the app.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_denoise_summary: Turns every denoiser on. Off: only the frame merge is left, and the photo is grainier but more detailed.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_dev_note_summary: The scam_dev.txt file changes these settings without the menu, with «key value» lines.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_dezipper_summary: Where frames were dropped because of motion, the edges of moving objects can turn jagged. This gives the base frame more weight and smooths such teeth. Zero is off, 4.5 is strong.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_diagnostics_summary: Saves the processing's intermediate stages as a ZIP in Documents/SCAMERA/Dumps, separately from the log. It slows processing down and takes space.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_dilate_floor_summary: Weak rejection below this threshold counts as noise and does not spread to nearby places. Higher: cleaner. Lower: fewer ghosts.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_dilate_summary: The safety zone round moving things. Lower: a wider zone with no halos where they meet the background. Higher: a narrower zone, closer to the outline.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_dnmerge_screen_summary: How the burst's frames are aligned and added into one, and how the noise is cleaned after the merge. Rows the chosen processing mode does not use are greyed.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_downsampler_summary: The method that scales the finished frame down to the chosen size. Lanczos gives a sharper result, Bilinear is faster.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_filter_variance_summar: How much of the difference between frames to count as noise. Higher: fewer still areas are mistaken for motion and more frames are merged. Lower: stricter toward motion.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fringe_method_summary: What removes the colour fringe on contrasty edges beside a bright light. The network cleans edges better and leaves the real colour of things alone. Classic is the earlier method.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fringe_net_boost_summa: Where the network removes a fringe, the classic method's result is taken instead if it removed more.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fringe_net_glow_summar: Coloured lamps, LEDs and signs keep their glow: the network does not take it for a fringe.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fringe_net_glow_title: Keep the glow of coloured lights
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fringe_net_green_summa: Also removes the green fringe. It appears on the edges of things that are out of focus.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fringe_net_hue_summary: From which hue a fringe counts as a defect. Lower: bluish fringes go too. Higher: only violet and magenta ones.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fringe_net_light_summa: How bright the light beside a fringe has to be, as a share of white. Lower: fringes beside dimmer lights go too.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fringe_net_near_summar: A fringe is removed only beside a light this many times brighter than it. The higher the value, the fewer places are touched.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fringe_net_near_title: How much brighter the light nearby
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fringe_net_noflip_summ: The correction can only weaken a fringe's colour. It never turns it into the opposite colour.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fringe_net_reach_summa: Wide removes a fringe up to 12 pixels from a bright edge, such as window frames against the sky. Narrow is a little faster.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fringe_net_strength_su: How much of the network's correction goes into the photo. At zero the fringe stays as it is.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fullres200_frames_summ: How many frames to take and merge for a 200 MP shot, from 3 to 64. The last frame is very short, for the highlights; the rest are ordinary. 4 by default. If memory runs short the burst is shorter, and the camera says so.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fullres50_frames_summa: How many frames to take and merge for a 50 MP shot. At zero the same as «Frames in the burst». At most 65. If memory runs short the burst is shorter, and the camera says so.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fullres50_zsl_summary: On: frames taken before the press are used, plus extra ones after it. Off: the whole burst is taken after the press.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_fwe_summary: How much more bright frames weigh than ordinary ones. Higher: cleaner shadows. Lower: their share is closer to ordinary frames.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_hdr_screen_summary: How the extra short frames for the highlights and long ones for the shadows are taken and merged.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_highlight_band_summary: Smooths the coloured dotted line on the edges of blown areas. Higher: stronger. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_highlight_chroma_summa: How coloured the light round a blown area may be for the blown area to take on its colour. Higher: the blown area is tinted. Lower: it stays whiter.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_highlight_chroma_title: Highlights: trust threshold for surrounding colour
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_highlight_defringe_sum: Removes the purple and green fringe round blown areas, contrasty branches and lamps. Higher: wide halos go too. Lower: only thin lines are cleaned. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_highlight_glow_summary: Blown white sources such as the sun, headlights and lamps, and the brightest zone round them, stay white without coloured rings, such as a yellow ring round the sun. Coloured sources keep their colour. Higher: stronger. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_highlight_recovery_sum: Rebuilds the true colour of blown highlights from the sensor channels that survived. Higher: tries harder to bring the colour back. Lower: a natural fade to white stays. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_hot_base_sigma_summary: The same for random spikes in the base frame. Lower: more is removed. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_hot_max_summary: Up to which light level hot pixels are looked for. Higher: in brighter scenes too. Lower: only at dusk and at night, so daytime micro-texture stays untouched.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_hot_sigma_summary: How far a dot has to stand out from its neighbours to count as a hot pixel, a coloured speck on night shots. Lower: faint defects go too, but detail may suffer. Higher: only bright white dots. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_kernel_bokeh_summary: The size of the blending spot in out-of-focus areas and bokeh: the sky, walls, a blurred background. Higher: the background blurs softer and cleaner, without grain. Lower: fine grain stays. It scales the automatic value: with «Kernel by the light» on, the light of the shot picks that value and 1 keeps it; off, 1 is the kernel as before.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_kernel_snr_summary: The three kernel sizes below are picked for each shot from how much light it had (the noise of its frames). In good light the kernel on textures and across edges gets narrower for finer detail, and flat areas such as the sky are smoothed a little more; in the dark textures and flat areas are smoothed more, so there is clearly less noise while edges stay. In between the kernel is as before. Works in «Fast», «Quality» and «Sport», on Bayer, Quad and Tetra (Tetra only on its daylight side). The sliders below scale the automatic value. Off: the kernel as before.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_kernel_summary: How wide the frame blending is. Higher: softer and cleaner. Lower: sharper but noisier.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_kernel_texture_summary: The size of the blending spot on ordinary textured surfaces such as sand, asphalt and leaves. Higher: smoother, cleaner surfaces. Lower: crisper micro-texture with more grain. It scales the automatic value: with «Kernel by the light» on, the light of the shot picks that value and 1 keeps it; off, 1 is the kernel as before.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_kernel_transition_summ: From which level of detail an area counts as flat and gets the bokeh kernel. Higher: more of the frame counts as flat and the picture is smoother. Lower: more of it counts as texture. It scales the automatic value: with «Kernel by the light» on, the light of the shot picks that value and 1 keeps it; off, 1 is the kernel as before.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_la_engine_summary: Where the precise frame matching is computed. Auto: on the CPU alongside the merge when possible, otherwise on the GPU before the merge. GPU: always on the GPU, leaving the CPU free. The result is the same.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_local_align_summary: Precise matching of the frames area by area. It gives more detail when shooting handheld and adds about 0.8 seconds of processing.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_lut_sigma_summary: Blurs very bright shadow frames. Higher: less noise in the shadows, but less detail too. One turns it off. It works in dark scenes where the bright frame comes from a long shutter.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mochi_summary: Before the merge, matches the colour and brightness of bright frames to the base one so the photo has no colour shifts.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_chroma_fill_sum: Fills in red and blue where there are few dots, so the colour of fine detail does not drop out. It helps with few frames, but with many it can tint edges.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_edge_scale_summ: Only with sub-frame splitting and the new kernel: the sharpness on edges. Lower: sharper but grainier. Higher: softer.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_fill_support_su: When the colour recovery starts. Higher: more often. Lower: only when data is really short. Works only with the recovery on.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_frames_summary: The most mosaic frames in the merge (the shot's overall frame count applies first). Higher: less noise but slower. Lower: faster but noisier.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_frames_title: Frames in the mosaic merge: at most
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_kernel_g_summar: The sharpness of the green channel on mosaic sensors. Higher: the most sharpness and detail, but noisier. Lower: softer and more reliable.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_kernel_rb_summa: Fights colour moiré on mosaic sensors. Lower: the colour grid and moiré go, with softer colour. Higher: sharper red and blue, with more false colour.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_kernel_scale_su: The blending width of the native Quad and Tetra T2 merge in daylight. Lower: sharper but noisier. Higher: softer and cleaner. At night and for Tetra T1 the merge uses its own tuned values.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_native_clamp_su: Limits how narrow the blending can get, which protects edges from teeth and colour fringes.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_native_edge_sca: The sharpness on edges in the native merge. Lower: sharper, but below 0.5 edges take on colour. Higher: softer. Works with the new merge kernel; at night the merge uses its own value.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_native_flat_sca: How much flat areas are smoothed in the native merge. Higher: less noise. Lower: grainier. Works with the new merge kernel.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_note_summary: These rows are for cameras whose frame arrives as a Quad 2×2 or Tetra 4×4 mosaic.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_path_summary: How the mosaic is merged. Native is faster and more detailed; splitting into sub-frames is the earlier way.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_remosaic_summar: On: the Quad or Tetra mosaic is assembled by the merge into an ordinary full-resolution frame. Off: the frames are merged without that and only a DNG is saved, the merged mosaic to develop in Scam Remosaic or another app.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_screen_summary: The merge for cameras that deliver a Quad 2×2 or Tetra 4×4 mosaic frame: the merge method and its settings.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_tetra_summary: How the Tetra 4×4 mosaic is merged. T1 is more detailed and faster; the others are earlier ways.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_wb_mode_summary: Where a 50 or 200 MP shot takes its white balance from: the viewfinder at the moment of the press or its own estimate of the frame.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_window_full_sum: Takes the whole square area round a dot: less noise on flat areas. Off: the window is as with splitting, and the merge goes the general way.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_mosaic_window_summary: The radius of the area the dots are taken from. Higher: less noise but slower. Lower: faster but noisier. For Quad and Tetra T2, 1 to 3 use the fast merge and 4 the general one, which is slower. Tetra T1's window is twice as wide.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_motion_boost_summary: Removes ghosts harder where parts of the frame move differently, such as hands or leaves. Works together with area-by-area frame matching.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_motion_threshold_summa: From which spread of motion the stronger rejection starts. Lower: fewer ghosts. Higher: less noise.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_noise_photon_summary: A correction of the noise in bright places by which the merge tells noise from motion. Higher: a smoother picture, but ghosts may appear. Lower: sharper and noisier.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_noise_readout_summary: The same correction for dark places. Higher: smoother shadows, but ghosts may appear. Lower: sharper and noisier.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_burst_frames_: How many frames are merged into one photo. The burst is taken as “Photo” takes it (the same exposure, frames from the viewfinder's buffer); this row only changes their number. More: less noise, longer processing. 0: as many as “Photo” takes; 1 to 3 count as 4.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_center_summar: With HDR: when the brightness range is larger than the tone can hold, it decides what to give up — highlights or shadows — by how much of the frame stays unclipped in the bright version. Lower: only the centre decides; higher: the whole frame alike. Default 0.47.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_curve_contras: Plus: darker shadows, brighter highlights — more contrast. Minus: softer and flatter. Black and white stay where they are. 0: the module's curve as it is.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_curve_mid_sum: Bends the tone curve: plus brightens the midtones, minus darkens them. Black and white stay where they are. 0: the module's curve as it is.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_dehaze_corner: How far a colour cast of the shadows (green, purple) is pulled to grey. 0: the shadows' colour as it is; higher: more neutral. Default 0.2.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_dehaze_max_da: Up to which brightness (0–255) the darkest part of the frame is looked for. Higher: the black point may sit higher — deeper, more contrasty shadows, but dark detail may be lost. Default 24.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_dehaze_percen: How much of the frame may become pure black. Higher: denser shadows; 0: no point is cut. Default 0.2.
Share of the frame in black, %
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_dehaze_shadin: The shadows are neutralised more where the lens darkens the corners and the camera lifts them (the cast shows more there). Off: the same over the whole frame.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_dehaze_summar: Removes the grey veil: the darkest parts of the frame become truly black, a colour cast in the shadows turns neutral. Off: the shadows as the tone leaves them, softer and lighter.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_ev_summary: Makes the finished photo brighter (plus) or darker (minus) by that many stops — by the tone's digital gain, the camera's shutter and ISO do not change. Adds to the style's “Exposure”. 0: as the tone sets it.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_fusion_base_s: In HDR the dark version of the frame — the one the highlights come from — is darkened a little more the larger the brightness range. Lower: darker, denser highlights; 1: no darkening. Default 0.9756.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_hdr_summary: How the tone builds the photo from the captured frame. Auto: the 2.7 / 3.1 rule decides by the scene's brightness range; with HDR the tone makes a bright and a dark version of the frame and blends them, without HDR the photo is the frame as the auto exposure exposed it. Always: blends in every scene — more shadow detail, but a calm scene may look flatter. Off: the frame as it is, no blending. The camera captures the same way in all three.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_highlight_per: The tone looks for the brightest place of the frame and ignores the very brightest points (glints, lamps). 99.7: 0.3 % of the points are ignored. Higher: even small glints count — with HDR the photo gets darker. Lower: with HDR small bright places turn white, but the photo is brighter. It also affects whether HDR turns on.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_highlight_tar: With HDR: how close to white the tone puts the brightest part of the frame. Lower: darker, denser highlights and a darker photo. Higher: brighter highlights, up to pure white. A part clipped in the frame stays white at any value. Without HDR it only affects whether HDR turns on. Default 0.95.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_max_gain_summ: How many times the tone may brighten the captured frame digitally. Lower: dark scenes stay darker with less shadow noise; higher: shadows are lifted further. Default 16.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_out_sat_per_s: How much saturation is added per stop of digital brightening: dark scenes lifted by gain get more (plus) or less (minus) colour. 0: no dependence.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_out_sat_summa: The overall colour of the finished photo: plus more vivid, minus paler. 0: no change (the tone's own colour stays).
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_out_vibrance_: The same for vibrance: how much is added per stop of digital brightening. 0: no dependence.
Above 1 the pale colours are lifted more than the already saturated ones; below 1 the other way round. 1: no change.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_shadow_ev_sum: With HDR: how bright the tone makes the bright version of the frame — the one the shadows and midtones come from. Plus: brighter shadows (and HDR turns on more often), minus: darker, more contrast. 0: as the tone sets it. The camera's exposure does not change.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v1_ccm_summar: The matrix turns the sensor's colours into the photo's. 1: the camera's own. Lower: paler colours; higher: more saturated, hues further apart.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v1_hdr_cap_su: The largest difference between V1's bright and dark versions of the frame: a more contrasty scene is cut down to it. Higher: shadows lifted further, denser highlights, a stronger HDR look; lower: more natural. Default 3.5.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v1_hdr_max_su: The largest range at which V1 still turns HDR on; above it the tone builds the photo from one version for the shadows. Higher: HDR in very contrasty scenes too. Used with HDR “Auto”. Default 6.8.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v1_hdr_min_su: The smallest brightness range (the bright version of the frame over the dark one) at which V1 turns HDR on. Lower: HDR in calm scenes too; higher: only in contrasty ones. Used with HDR “Auto”. Default 1.45.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v1_lowfreq_ch: On: only the colour is transferred, the shadows' brightness stays. Off: the brightness too — shadows closer to the merge, but a brightness difference then counts as motion as well, and with a low threshold the transfer turns itself off more often.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v1_lowfreq_st: The share of the shadows' colour taken from the merge: 1 all of it, 0 none.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v1_lowfreq_su: In V1's HDR the colour of the shadows comes from our merge of the frames instead of the recomputed dark exposure: shadows without greyness or colour blotches. Off: the shadows' colour as the original recomputation gives it.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v1_lowfreq_th: How far the merge's colour may differ from the picture for the transfer to be trusted. Lower: weakened more often (safer, fewer motion traces); higher: applied more boldly. Default 16.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v1_lowfreq_ti: V1: shadow colour from the merge
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v2_hdr_forgiv: How many times the scene's range may exceed the “HDR strength” for V2 to still turn HDR on. Above that the tone builds the photo from one version for the shadows. Used with HDR “Auto”. Default 1.4.
V2: range past the HDR strength
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v2_hdr_max_su: The largest difference between V2's bright and dark versions of the frame: a more contrasty scene is cut down to it. Higher: shadows lifted further, denser highlights; lower: more natural. Default 8.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v2_hdr_min_su: The smallest brightness range (the bright version of the frame over the dark one) at which V2 turns HDR on. Lower: HDR in calm scenes too; higher: only in contrasty ones. Used with HDR “Auto”. Default 1.33.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v2_levels_sum: 10: the full look of V2, local contrast at every scale. 8: as its postview — a little less contrast on large shapes (the sky, big shadows).
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v2_memory_sum: The share of the phone's free memory V2 may take. A frame that needs more (photo size 1.5× / 2×) is processed by V1 instead. Higher: V2 on larger frames too, with more risk of the app being closed for lack of memory. Default 60.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_v2_saturation: How vivid V2's colours are: plus more colour, minus less. 0: V2's own look.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_version_summa: V1: two exposures of the frame through the 1024-point curve, blended by the 2.7 pyramid. V2: the RAW fusion of 3.1 with a short and a long gain and the 4096-point curve. Also on the “Tone” tile of the mode's adjustments.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_vf_ev_summary: A brightness correction of the viewfinder alone, in stops: if on your phone it is brighter or darker than the finished photo, match it here. The photo is not affected.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_vf_match_summ: How far the viewfinder is carried to the small copy of the photo to come. 1: fully; 0: the picture as in “Photo”.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_vf_smooth_sum: How many seconds the viewfinder's brightness takes to follow a new scene. Lower: faster, but it may flicker; higher: calmer, with a delay. Default 0.5.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_oldstyle_vf_tone_summa: The viewfinder shows the look of the ScamMaster photo to come: the 2.7 / 3.1 tone module builds a small copy of the photo from the viewfinder's frame, and the picture on the screen is carried to its tone and colour part by part (the detail stays the camera's). Off: the viewfinder exactly as in “Photo” (the style only); the photo is not affected.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_output_summary: How many pixels the photo gets. 2× gives more detail but takes about four times longer to process.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_post_snr_summary: At night the Resolve denoise smooths the grain of flat areas (sky, walls, skin) more and leaves texture and edges as they are; some fine grain stays. By day and off: as set.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_processing_summary: How the camera builds a photo from its burst. Fast: the photo is ready noticeably sooner. Quality: slower, but motion, water and fine detail come out cleaner. Every mode always makes the photo its own way and never hands it to another, on any sensor (Quad, Tetra, DCG) and through GPU failures.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_profile_summary: Writes how long each stage of a shot takes to a file, to find what slows it down. The merge runs slower; the photo itself does not change.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_resize_summary: Scales the finished photo down to this size, keeping the frame's proportions. If the chosen size is not smaller than the merged one, the photo stays as it is. For 16 or 20 MP from a 12 MP sensor set Resolution to 1.5× or 2×.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_resolve_speckle_enable: Removes lone colour dots before the pyramid denoiser. Brightness does not change.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_resolve_speckle_streng: How far a defective dot's colour is replaced with that of its surroundings. At one it is replaced completely; lower only weakens it. Brightness does not change.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_resolve_speckle_thresh: How far a dot's colour must differ from its neighbours to count as a defect. Lower: even faint stray dots are removed. Higher: only coarse ones.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_s61_max_summary: Up to which light level a shot counts as a night shot. The merge's night noise settings depend on it, and in Auto so does the new kernel. Higher: brighter scenes count as night too. It does not affect 200 MP shots at 4×: those are taken in daylight.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_s61_min_motion_summary: In daylight on Auto with precise frame matching: from how much hand shake the new kernel turns on. Lower: more often (a tripod shot gets noisier). Higher: less often.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_s61_min_motion_title: New kernel by day: hand shake from, px
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_sabre61_summary: A new way of blending the frames: more detail at night and handheld. Off: the earlier kernel.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_shasta_auto_count_summ: The number of long frames follows the share of shadows in the frame, from one to three. «Shadow frames: count» sets the most.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_shasta_deep_summary: If the frame has deep shadows, the long frames are taken two stops brighter with a shutter of up to 1/60 s.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_shasta_ev_summary: How much brighter the bright frames are than ordinary ones, in stops. Higher: cleaner shadows, but each frame is noisier. Lower: the other way round.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_shasta_frames_summary: How many bright frames to take. Higher: cleaner shadows, but longer shooting and more memory.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_shasta_max_ratio_summa: For Auto: how many times brighter than an ordinary frame a bright one may be. Higher: brighter ones are allowed. Lower: stricter.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_shasta_mode_summary: When a bright frame is dropped. Auto: if it is blurred. Always: only if there was motion in the frame.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_shasta_motion_max_summ: For Always: how much motion a bright frame may have. Higher: it is used more often. Lower: less often.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_shasta_motion_max_titl: Shadow frames: drop on motion, % of the frame
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_shasta_sharpness_summa: For Auto: how sharp a bright frame has to be. Higher: blurred ones are dropped more often. Lower: less often.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_shasta_summary: Extra bright frames after the press: less noise in the shadows. Off: faster shooting with no risk of blur.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_snr_scale_summary: For the earlier kernel only: how noisy to take the shot to be. Higher: softer and cleaner. Lower: sharper and noisier.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_snr_scale_title: Noise scale for the SNR key
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_tensor_noise_summary: For the earlier kernel only: how much noise not to take for edges. Higher: smoother flat areas. Lower: sharper.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_tone_version_summary: The photo's tone: brightness, local contrast, curve and colour. V1 is the tone as before, V2 the new version. Its settings: “Tone settings” below.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_weight_cap_summary: The largest weight a bright frame gets in the merge. Higher: cleaner shadows. Lower: bright frames count for less.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_aces_a_summary: How steeply brightness rises in the highlights of the ACES curve. Higher: brighter, livelier lights. Lower: a smooth, muted passage to the highlights.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_aces_d_summary: The passage between mid-tones and shadows on the ACES curve. Higher: a softer passage and darker lights. Lower: harder mid-tone contrast.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_aces_on_summary: Turns on the ACES curve instead of AgX: deep contrast, softly compressed highlights. The other curves turn off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_aces_pre_gain_summ: The brightness of the signal entering the ACES curve. Higher: a brighter frame whose mid-tones fill sooner. Lower: a darker frame with more headroom.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_aces_toe_summary: How softly the darkest tones go to black. Higher: softer, lighter shadows with more detail in the gloom. Lower: deeper, more contrasty shadows. It works on every shot, with any curve.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_aces_toe_title: Deep shadow softness (fusion and ACES toe)
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ae_max_boost_summa: How many times the camera may brighten a frame in the dark. Higher: dusk and night shots come out lighter. Lower: night shots are darker, but without extra noise and unnatural brightness.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ae_min_limit_summa: The floor below which the camera does not lower the exposure. Higher: frames in bright sun do not come out too dark. Lower: the camera may drop the exposure further for bright sunsets. A shot that includes short highlight frames never gets darker than it was taken.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ae_screen_summary: How the camera chooses a photo's brightness: metering, protection of bright places, the shadow lift and the limits the exposure stays within.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ae_target_summary: How light the photo comes out: the brightness auto-exposure aims for. Higher: lighter. Lower: darker. A shot with very bright places never gets darker than it was taken.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_agx_inset_summary: How bright coloured things such as neon, a sunset or headlights go into clipping. At 100 percent they fade to white smoothly, as on film. Near zero colours in the lights stay harshly saturated and clip abruptly.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_agx_look_summary: Ready variants of the AgX curve: neutral, punchy and contrasty, soft pastel, a warm film look. Custom takes the values of the rows below.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_agx_slope_summary: The slope of the middle of the AgX curve, the overall mid-tone contrast. Higher: more contrast. Lower: softer and flatter. Works in the Custom look.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_blend_smoothness_s: How soft the borders are between areas of different exposure. Higher: wide, unnoticeable passages between light and dark zones. Lower: the layers blend more selectively and the HDR effect is stronger.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_bracket_denoise_su: Cleans the short frames of noise before they go into the highlights. Higher: no colour sand inside bright lamps. Lower: small glowing lettering stays as sharp as possible. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_bright_thresh_summ: The brightness above which the camera starts to compress and dim the highlights to save them from burning out. Lower: it dims them sooner and harder, keeping cloud and lamp detail but darker lights. Higher: the lights stay bright and contrasty, with more risk of clipping.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ccm_matrix_summary: Nine numbers separated by commas, row after row. «1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1» changes nothing.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ccm_override_summa: The colour is computed with the matrix of the row below, unless a ready profile is chosen. The matrix rows are scaled to sum to 1, so grey stays grey.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ccm_profile_summar: A ready colour matrix for this sensor instead of the system one. Chosen separately for the module and for 50 and 200 MP shooting.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ccm_sat_summary: Only for the OPPO Find X7 Ultra with the AgX look: the saturation with OPPO's colour matrix. Higher: brighter colours. Lower: paler ones.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_cct_gain_b_summary: The blue channel's factor in the colour matrix. Higher: more cold blue. Lower: a warmer photo.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_cct_gain_g_summary: The green channel's factor in the colour matrix. Higher: the photo shifts to green. Lower: to magenta.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_cct_gain_r_summary: The red channel's factor in the colour matrix. Higher: more red, a warmer photo. Lower: less red.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_cct_sat_summary: The base saturation of colours in the sensor's matrix. Higher: every colour is richer from the moment the raw frame is read. Lower: a restrained, muted palette. Brightness does not change.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_clarity_summary: The local contrast of medium-sized detail. It brings out the relief of objects, fabric and walls without oversharpening the fine stuff. Below zero the picture softens instead.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_classic_weight_cen: The brightness the blend takes as ideal for a pixel. Higher: lighter layers are preferred and the frame is lighter. Lower: darker layers, a deeper frame. Works with the classic layout.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_classic_weight_ext: The share of the layer that compresses bright zones the most (−2.5 stops). Higher: detail returns in the brightest lights and glints. Lower: the natural glow stays. Works with the classic layout.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_classic_weight_hl_: The share of the layer that compresses highlights moderately (−1.2 stops). Higher: the sky and light things keep their texture without losing overall contrast. Lower: the lights stay bright. Works with the classic layout.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_classic_weight_mid: How much the normally exposed layer matters. Higher: the picture stays closer to the original frame, without an HDR effect. Lower: the layers that lighten shadows and compress highlights weigh more. Works with the classic layout.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_classic_weight_sha: The share of the layer that lightens shadows (+1.8 stops). Higher: detail is pulled out of dark areas. Lower: the shadows stay deep and contrasty. Works with the classic layout.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_contrast_boost_sum: Extra contrast for dull and overcast shots. Higher: such a picture becomes deeper and more expressive. At zero the scene stays soft and flat as it is.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_curve_boost_summar: Adds contrast to your own curve in flat, low-contrast scenes, the way AgX does. Zero is off, one is the same as AgX.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_curve_contrast_sum: An S-shaped contrast over the whole range: on the plus side shadows get darker and highlights lighter.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_curve_deep_shadows: Moves only the darkest shadows. On the plus side they lift, on the minus side they get deeper.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_curve_extreme_high: Moves only the brightest highlights. On the plus side they are muted, on the minus side they get lighter still.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_curve_highlight_co: Changes the curve's steepness only in the bright tones and highlights.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_curve_lift_summary: Smoothly lifts or lowers the mid-tones. The black and white points stay where they are.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_curve_offset_summa: Shifts the whole curve evenly up or down.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_curve_on_summary: Turns on your own tone curve instead of AgX. It is set from −5 to +5 stops round middle grey. The other curves turn off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_curve_points_summa: Your tone curve. A tap adds a point, a drag moves it, a hold deletes it.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_curve_shadow_contr: Changes the curve's steepness only in the shadows and dark mid-tones.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_curves_screen_summ: The photo's overall tone curve. AgX works by default; ACES, Uchimura or a curve you draw can replace it.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_dark_pixel_thresh_: Which scenes the camera takes for dull and low in contrast: fog, an overcast sky. Higher: more scenes count as flat and get extra contrast more often. Lower: only really faded shots do.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_dark_thresh_summar: How much scene contrast it takes for the camera to lift the shadows by itself. Lower: shadows are lightened even in moderately contrasty scenes. Higher: only in very contrasty ones, such as against the sun; in ordinary shooting the shadows stay deep.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_delta_chroma_summa: Removes the coloured line on the dark side of contrasty edges. Higher: stronger. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_dn_factor_summary: The final clean-up of leftover noise after the merge. Higher: noise goes completely at the cost of slight smoothing. At zero the filter is off and the merge's own result stays. With “Adapt to the light” on this value scales the automatic one: at night flat areas get more.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_dn_grain_summary: Brings back a fine natural texture where few frames were merged, so things do not look like plasticine. Higher: a more textured photo, as from a big camera. At zero the image is perfectly smooth.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_dn_luma_revert_sum: The balance between the merge's raw sharpness and the denoiser's smoothness in still areas. Higher: fine detail stays crisp, as after the merge, with natural grain. Lower: a smooth, noiseless picture. With “Adapt to the light” on this value scales the automatic one: at night flat areas keep less of it.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_dn_motion_revert_s: How much of its own sharpness is kept where motion left few frames to merge. Higher: a moving subject stays crisp, with its natural noise. Lower: the denoiser smooths it more.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_dynamic_cct_streng: How far the colour matrix is softened by ISO 6400. At zero not at all, at one only the white balance is left.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_dynamic_cct_summar: At high ISO the colour matrix is softened. There is less colour noise and the colours are a little calmer.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ef_coarse_summary: How large the zones are in which brightness is evened out, in pixels along the short side of the coarsest layer. Higher: the tone follows small zones and the picture is flatter. Lower: large zones, with more overall contrast.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_film_toe_summary: Presses the black point down, as film does. Higher: the darkest shadows turn deep and velvety and the milky haze goes. At zero the shadows stay open and soft.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_flat_protect_summa: Keeps sharpening from bringing out grain and noise on flat, even areas such as the sky, skin and walls. Higher: cleaner, but the finest texture is lost. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_fusion_layout_summ: The layers of different brightness the photo is built from. Ours is the current way. Classic is four layers at −2.5, −1.2, 0 and +1.8 stops, with their own weights in the group below.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_gamma_summary: The gamma exponent of the output. Higher: lighter mid-tones and shadows, a flatter picture. Lower: darker and more contrasty.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_gamma_type_summary: The formula that turns the photo's brightness into screen brightness. Pure power is a plain gamma with dense shadows. sRGB and Rec.709 are the standards' curves, with lighter, cleaner shadows.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_highlight_str_summ: How hard blown areas are dimmed so that their detail shows. Higher: a bright sky, the sun and lamps are dimmed more and show relief. Lower: the lights stay bright and shining. When a shot includes short highlight frames, the strength comes from their real range and this value does almost nothing.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_hl_blend_summary: The balance between saving detail in blown areas and the scene's usual brightness. Lower: highlight protection comes first, the frame is darker, sky and lamps hold. Higher: the frame's brightness comes first, the exposure drops less and bright sources may burn out.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_hl_boost_summary: How hard overexposed areas are darkened once the camera finds them. Higher: bright lamps and blown areas are dimmed more and show their texture. Lower: a gentle touch. At zero the lights are not compressed.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_hl_overflow_summar: How much clipping of bright sources the exposure allows. Lower: the camera guards the lights more strictly, dropping the exposure sooner for the texture of lamps and sky and lifting the shadows afterwards. Higher: bright lights shine more and the exposure is not lowered.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_hl_soft_summary: A blown area fades smoothly to pure white, and coloured light to its own colour at full brightness. Higher: the transition starts sooner and is softer. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_hl_white_summary: Bright coloured light such as LEDs and neon turns white. Higher: it whitens sooner. Lower: it keeps its colour longer. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_hr_knee_summary: The brightness above which lights start to be compressed. Higher: only the most blinding sources are touched. Lower: compression starts sooner and takes in every bright glint.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_hr_room_summary: How bright the compressed lights may get. Higher: the lights stay bright and striking. Lower: they are pressed down harder and the colour of sign letters and lamp filaments shows better.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_hr_strength_summar: Holds colour and detail in very bright lights such as neon, street lamps and the sun. At one signs keep their rich colour instead of burning into plain white. At zero it is off and the lights shine at full brightness.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_input_ev_summary: Shifts the brightness of the data entering the processing, in stops. Leave 0 for normal shooting: auto-exposure brings part of the brightness back anyway.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_macro_contrast_sum: The contrast of the mid-tones round middle brightness. Higher: a fuller, more expressive picture with denser shadows and brighter lights. Lower: softer and more even.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_metering_summary: The way the scene's light is measured. Matrix weighs the whole frame, centre-weighted favours the centre, spot measures right at the focus point.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ms_chroma_l0_summa: Lone coloured pixels. Higher: fine colour ripple goes. Lower: thin coloured threads and lines stay.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ms_chroma_l1_summa: Medium colour blotches on walls and asphalt. Higher: colour smudges in the gloom go. Lower: natural colour transitions stay.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ms_chroma_l2_summa: Large colour blotches in deep shadows. Higher: crimson and green patches in the corners of night shots go. Lower: the shades of night lighting stay.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ms_chroma_summary: How hard coloured dots and blotches, green, purple and red, are removed. Higher: clean, even colours. Lower: colour is barely touched.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ms_denoise_summary: Multi-level noise cleaning at three scales, fine grain and medium and large blotches, separately for brightness and colour. Off: only the main noise reduction is left.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ms_luma_l0_summary: The finest, dot-like grain. Higher: fine sand goes from flat surfaces. Lower: the crispest hairs and pores.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ms_luma_l1_summary: Flaky medium-sized noise. Higher: cleaner at dusk. Lower: the natural micro-relief stays.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ms_luma_l2_summary: Large unevenness and waves of brightness in the dark. Higher: coarse blotches go from night shots. Lower: large gradients stay without smearing.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ms_luma_summary: How hard grey grain is removed. Higher: smooth, even surfaces. Lower: texture and a little grain stay.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ms_model_scale_sum: How closely the denoiser's strength follows the sensor's noise on this shot. Higher: it cleans harder in low light and at high ISO. At zero it acts the same on every frame.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_ms_shadow_summary: Cleans dark areas harder, where noise is worst. Higher: clean shadows without colour debris. At zero the strength is the same over the whole frame.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_night_dim_summary: How strongly auto-exposure acts overall. Above 1 the brightness correction is stronger. Below 1 it is weaker and the photo stays closer to how it was taken. A shot that includes short highlight frames never gets darker than it was taken.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_night_thresh_summa: Keeps the brightness from being pushed at night as the sensor noise grows. Lower: the exposure is held back harder and the night stays dark and clean. Higher: brightness is pulled up in the dark even if noise comes with it.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_rl_screen_summary: Restoring the lens's sharpness in three stages, from diffraction to fine texture, with halo protection.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_shadow_str_summary: How hard the dark parts of the frame are pulled up. Higher: lighter shadows that show what the gloom hid. Lower: the shadows stay dark, contrasty and natural.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_bilateral_am: How much the texture of objects is boosted without halos at borders. Higher: more relief, but more noise too. Lower: a soft, smooth texture. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_bilateral_co: Which brightness step counts as a border that must not be blurred. Higher: larger steps are boosted too. Lower: the filter stops strictly at any contrasty seam.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_bilateral_ra: The size of the detail boosted by the edge-preserving sharpening. Higher: larger detail is caught. Lower: the finest sharpening. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_domain_summa: The brightness the sharpening is computed on. «After exposure»: in dark scenes the sharpening is weaker on strong edges.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_edge_thinnin: Removes thick, swollen outlines after strong sharpening. On the plus side thick lines become thin and neat. On the minus side sharp strokes are softened.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_film_grain_s: Adds fine film grain, strongest in the mid-tones. Higher: more visible grain that hides digital noise. At zero the picture is smooth.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_gain_summary: How much fine detail goes into the photo. Higher: sharper and crisper. Lower: softer. At zero the photo's own fine detail goes too: softer than with no sharpening at all. The detailed settings are on the Sharpening page.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_gf_eps_e3_su: How carefully the filter treats edges, in thousandths. Lower: it follows outlines closely without halos and boosts only faint texture. Higher: it acts like an ordinary soft blur and touches visible edges too.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_gf_lc_summar: How much the hidden texture of stone, wood, fabric and skin shows. Higher: tangible volume and micro-contrast. Lower: a calm, natural texture. Below zero the texture is smoothed.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_gf_radius_su: The scale at which the photo is split into shape and relief. Higher: large folds and structures stand out. Lower: the fine texture grid. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_halo_control: Removes the light fringe along contrasty borders such as wires against the sky or branches. Higher: fewer halos, less visible sharpening. Lower: more contrasty outlines, with halos.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_note_summary: This is the photo's only sharpening; it works on brightness before the tone processing. Its overall strength is «Sharpening strength» on the main page, and the rows here weaken or boost its separate parts.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_protect_high: Gently weakens sharpening in bright highlights. Higher: no harsh traces or spiky halos round lamps and glints. Lower: glints are sharpened like the rest of the frame.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_protect_shad: Gently weakens sharpening in deep shadows so that noise does not show. Higher: cleaner shadows. At zero shadows are sharpened like the rest of the frame.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl1_damping_: Holds the restoration back where the picture is already sharp, so that grain and rings do not grow. Higher: only real detail is boosted. At zero the filter works at full strength, but noise grows.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl1_kernel_s: The shape of the blur the first stage corrects. Gaussian: light scattered in the lens. Disc: slight smear and defocus. Airy: the diffraction of a phone's small optics.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl1_rad_summ: The radius of the lens's blur spot, in pixels. Higher: corrects strong defocus and mush, with possible halos. Lower: fine tuning of small detail. Zero turns the stage off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl2_damping_: Holds the restoration back where the picture is already sharp: fewer rings and less noise. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl2_kernel_s: The shape of the blur corrected by the second stage: medium detail and defocus. Gaussian: scattered light. Disc: smear and defocus. Airy: diffraction.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl2_rad_summ: The radius of the blur spot for this stage, in pixels. Higher: corrects larger blur. Lower: finer. Zero turns the stage off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl3_damping_: Holds the restoration back where the picture is already sharp: fewer rings and less noise. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl3_kernel_s: The shape of the blur corrected by the third stage: fine texture. Gaussian: scattered light. Disc: smear and defocus. Airy: diffraction.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl3_rad_summ: The radius of the blur spot for this stage, in pixels. Higher: corrects larger blur. Lower: finer. Zero turns the stage off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl_halo_cont: Removes the dark and light fringes that appear round contrasty borders when sharpness is restored. Higher: a clean result without fringes. Lower: harder restoration.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl_halo_macr: The local contrast above which the restoration fades out. Higher: it works even on sharp, contrasty seams, with possible halos. Lower: only on fine, faint texture.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_rl_halo_marg: How much fine contrast is allowed before the halo protection steps in. Higher: the finest strokes are restored without clipping. Lower: borders are held more strictly.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_scale_summar: The scale of every sharpening radius. At zero it is chosen by the photo's size. Higher: coarser sharpening. Lower: finer.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_screen_summa: The detailed sharpening settings: the unsharp mask, edges, local contrast and protection of shadows and highlights from oversharpening.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_sobel_amount: How strongly the geometric edges of objects are emphasised. Higher: architecture, lettering and crisp lines stand out more. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_sobel_thresh: From which contrast an edge gets extra sharpening. Higher: only clear, crisp edges are boosted. Lower: even faint relief.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_usm_radius_s: The size of the detail the unsharp mask brings out. Lower: micro-texture such as pores, fabric, sand. Higher: large outlines and object borders, with more visible halos. Zero turns it off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_sharp_usm_thresh_s: Brightness steps below this threshold count as noise and are not sharpened. Higher: flat areas stay clean, without grain. At zero sharpening is strongest, but noise is sharpened too.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_skin_hue_center_su: The hue the skin mask is built round, in degrees. Higher: the mask expects yellowish, peachy skin. Lower: pinkish red skin.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_skin_hue_shift_sum: Shifts the skin's hue round the colour wheel, in degrees. On the minus side skin is pinker and rosier and yellowness goes. On the plus side warmer and more golden.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_skin_luma_min_summ: From which brightness an area may count as skin. Higher: the mask works only on well-lit parts of the face and does not catch warm things in the shade. Lower: it covers the face even in the gloom.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_skin_protect_summa: Keeps faces from turning red or carrot-coloured when you raise vibrance, the mixer or colour grading. At one the skin tone stays natural against any background, at zero skin is saturated along with the scene.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_skin_sat_shift_sum: The saturation of faces only; the background stays. On the plus side faces look more tanned and rosy, on the minus side lighter and paler.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_texture_summary: Adds local contrast after the tone processing: textures look more expressive.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_tone_screen_summar: How the photo's brightness is evened out inside the frame: how far highlights are dimmed, shadows lifted and layers of different exposure blended.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_uchi_a_summary: The contrast of the mid-tones. Higher: more contrasty, better separated mid-tones. Lower: a flatter, softer picture.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_uchi_b_summary: Lifts the black level. Higher: a faded, matte black, as in old photos. At zero black stays clean and deep.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_uchi_c_summary: How steeply the curve bends in its dark part. Higher: darker, more contrasty shadows. Lower: lighter shadows that show more.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_uchi_l_summary: How long the mid-tones run evenly before the highlights start to compress. Higher: a wider range of natural tones. Lower: the lights compress sooner.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_uchi_m_summary: Where shadows end and mid-tones begin. Higher: a wider shadow zone. Lower: shorter shadows, the even mid-tones start lower.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_uchi_on_summary: Turns on the Uchimura curve instead of AgX, in the Gran Turismo style: even mid-tones, a soft highlight roll-off, adjustable shadows. The other curves turn off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_uchi_p_summary: The ceiling of white on the Uchimura curve. Higher: brighter, harder lights. Lower: the brightest point is muted.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_uchi_post_gain_sum: The frame's final brightness after the Uchimura curve. Higher: everything is lighter, white included. Lower: a darker finished frame.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_uchi_pre_gain_summ: The brightness entering the Uchimura curve. Higher: the whole frame is lighter. Lower: darker.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_v2_agx_hue_lock_su: Keeps blue skies from turning cyan near white.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_v2_agx_look_summar: Golden warms the AgX output and turns the hue lock off; the others change nothing by themselves.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_v2_clarity_summary: Mid-frequency local contrast of the fusion. Higher: more structure.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_v2_hr_amount_summa: Rebuilds a clipped channel from the others near white. 0: off.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_v2_skin_hue_center: The hue the skin mask centres on (degrees).
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_vibrance_green_sum: The vibrance of grass and leaves. Higher: fresh, lush greens that do not turn garish. Lower: a natural, restrained hue.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_vibrance_hl_str_su: Keeps colour rich in the bright parts of the frame, such as sunsets and sunlit clouds. Higher: richer sunsets and glints. Lower: the lights are closer to neutral.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_vibrance_mid_summa: The vibrance of the main subjects in the mid-tones. On the plus side everyday things look brighter, on the minus side the mid-tones are muted.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_vibrance_saturated: An extra boost for colours that are bright to begin with: clothes, flowers, signs. Higher: even richer. Lower: no garish tones.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_vibrance_shadows_s: The vibrance of dark areas. On the plus side shadows are more colourful and warmer, on the minus side they lose colour and there is less colour noise in the gloom.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_vibrance_sky_summa: The vibrance of blue sky and water. Higher: a deep blue or azure sky. Lower: the sky's colour is not pushed.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_vibrance_summary: A smart colour boost: it enriches muted, calm hues and does not oversaturate ones that are already bright. Higher: calm tones come alive. Lower: a softer, more restrained palette.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_weight_bright_summ: The weight of the brightened layer, the one in charge of the shadows. Higher: lighter shadows. Lower: darker ones.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_weight_center_summ: The layer brightness the blend takes as best in our layout. Higher: a lighter photo. Lower: a darker one. When a shot includes short highlight frames, the centre is taken 0.15 higher.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_weight_dark2_summa: The weight of the second dark layer, between the highlight layer and the normal one. Higher: darker, more detailed bright places. Lower: brighter ones.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_weight_hl_summary: The weight of the darkest layer, the one in charge of the highlights. Higher: darker, more detailed lights. Lower: brighter ones. When a shot includes short highlight frames, half this weight is used.
strings.prefs_scam_hybrid_why_weight_mid_summary: The weight of the normally exposed layer. Higher: the photo stays closer to its original brightness. Lower: a stronger HDR effect.
